cashbox.paymentsOff: Budgets and payments is not enabled: the count includes only the movements recorded in the till.
cashbox.footnote: Till movements for {date}. Patient payments are recorded under Payments.

totals.offTill: {amount} never passed through the drawer, so the count does not see it.

movements.empty: No till movements on this day.

form.conceptHint: Required: it is what makes the row readable three months from now.
form.methodNotCounted: Not counted in the cash count

closing.title: Till count
closing.openingFloatHint: What was in the drawer at opening. Carried from the last count; change it if that is not what was there.
closing.countedHint: Count the drawer and type what is there. The expected figure appears afterwards, on purpose.
closing.notesHint: Required when the count does not match: an unexplained difference is no use to anybody.
closing.notesPlaceholder: e.g. a taxi was paid and not recorded
closing.closingFloatHint: What you leave as float. The rest comes out of the drawer.
closing.otherChannels: Also came in that day, outside the drawer:
closing.reopenWarning: The count stops standing and the day's movements become editable again. The previous count is not deleted: it stays in the history.
closing.reopenReasonPlaceholder: e.g. counted before the drawer was emptied

blocked.count: Count the drawer and type the amount.
blocked.notes: The count does not match: say what happened.
blocked.float: You cannot leave more for tomorrow than you counted.

period.title: Period cut
period.pendingWhy: Days where money moved in the drawer and nobody counted it. Their amounts are not in the totals above.
period.otherChannels: Also came in, outside the drawer:
period.empty: No counts in this period yet.

late.title: Entries after the count
late.lede: Recorded against a day that had already been counted, so they are not in its arqueo.
late.how: Either reopen the day and count it again, or write down what is being done with each one and it comes off this list.
late.ackTitle: What is being done with this?
late.resolutionHint: Required. Seen is not a decision anybody can act on three months from now.

summaryTile.title: Till
summaryTile.pending: {n} day not counted | {n} days not counted
summaryTile.quietHint: No money has passed through the drawer this fortnight.
